\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows,positioning}

\makeatletter
\pgfarrowsdeclare{process chevron}{process chevron}{
  \pgfarrowsleftextend{-1.2pt}
  \pgfarrowssetlineend{.2pt}
  \pgfarrowsrightextend{1.8pt}
}{
  \pgfsetroundcap
  \pgfpathmoveto{\pgfqpoint{-1.2pt}{-1.5pt}}
  \pgfpathlineto{\pgfqpoint{1.8pt}{0pt}}
  \pgfpathlineto{\pgfqpoint{-1.2pt}{1.5pt}}
  \pgfusepathqstroke
}
\pgfarrowsdeclare{process stop}{process stop}{
  \pgfarrowsleftextend{-.4pt}
  \pgfarrowssetlineend{0pt}
  \pgfarrowsrightextend{.4pt}
}{
  \pgfsetbuttcap
  \pgfpathmoveto{\pgfqpoint{0pt}{-2pt}}
  \pgfpathlineto{\pgfqpoint{0pt}{2pt}}
  \pgfusepathqstroke
}
\pgfarrowsdeclarecombine[.7pt]{queued}{queued}{process chevron}{process chevron}{process chevron}{process chevron}
\pgfarrowsdeclarecombine*[.5pt]{committed}{committed}{process chevron}{process chevron}{process stop}{process stop}
\makeatother

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[
  state/.style={draw,rounded corners=2pt,minimum width=20mm,minimum height=8mm},
  node distance=18mm and 22mm
]
  \node[state,fill=blue!8] (draft) {Draft};
  \node[state,fill=orange!10,right=of draft] (review) {Review};
  \node[state,fill=green!10,right=of review] (done) {Done};
  \draw[blue!70!black,very thick,-{queued}] (draft) -- node[above]{queue} (review);
  \draw[green!45!black,very thick,-{committed}] (review) -- node[above]{commit} (done);
  \draw[red!70!black,thick,{committed}-{queued}] (done.south) |- ([yshift=-11mm]draft.south) -| (draft.south)
    node[pos=.5,below=2pt]{rollback};
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
